prompts.grass: Create ONE seamless repeating pixel-art grass ground tile for a romantic garden wedding RPG. Reference tile is color guidance only: muted warm sage and olive lawn, slightly sunlit, no saturated emerald. Unlike the nearly flat reference, show clearly readable small 2-to-4-pixel clusters of grass blades, short V-shaped tufts, occasional tiny dry blades, and gentle irregular darker and lighter grass patches. Final intended tile resolution 32x32 pixels; design at that density with a limited harmonious palette of 8-12 colors. Top-down orthographic ground, completely opaque, edge-to-edge grass. No flowers, no paths, no objects, no square border, no central spotlight, no vignette, no directional shadow or large recognizably repeated feature. Seamless all four edges. Texture should read as outdoor turf at small scale while supporting small wedding characters. Pixel art, not photographic noise or blurry painted texture.
prompts.meadow-sprig: Create ONE isolated transparent pixel-art ground decoration for a tiny romantic wedding garden RPG. Genuinely transparent background. Entire small patch centered.

Entire mound isolated, no container, no floor, no ground patch, no letters. Transparent background. Flowers should differ visibly from reference's dense round rose arrangement while coordinating with it.
